requirements: R1: Accurately sync GitHub PR status to internal system when a PR is closed without being merged.
R2: Prevent task-generation loop by correctly identifying unmerged closed PRs so tasks do not falsely appear as completed.

slices.title: Patch PR sync logic for unmerged closed PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync patch for this epic, I want to accurately detect unmerged closed PRs and prevent generation loops, so that internal tasks correctly reflect GitHub reality.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR on GitHub is closed without being merged
When the system synchronizes the task status
Then the internal task is not marked as done but reflects the unmerged state
slices.tocConstraintRef: False-positive task completion blocking Flow Core from accurate progress tracking
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive 'done' task sync errors to 0
